status: Specification only; branch, application code and deployment have not been created.
goal: Build an isolated TypeScript timesheet prototype inside Sunny with existing styling, individual shift approval and weekly summaries.
agreed_workflow: An authenticated employee scans a recognized vehicle-start QR: immediately clock in before the starting checklist.
If already clocked in, preserve the active shift and its original start time.
Successful return-checklist submission clocks out and automatically submits the completed shift for approval.
Timesheet Clock In and Clock Out buttons support trainees and other exceptions.
Employees request missing hours or corrections; managers review, edit and approve individual shifts.
Weekly summaries separate approved hours, pending hours, active shifts and attention flags.

steps.title: Inspect the existing project
actions: Read repository instructions and inspect uncommitted changes.
Verify the actual development branch, auth roles, styling, test framework, QR flow and return-checklist submission.
Inspect CI and Firebase environment separation; preserve unrelated work.
done_when: The implementation paths and development base are verified.

steps.title: Create the isolated branch and preview setup
actions: Create timesheet-branch from the verified development tip. If it exists, inspect and reuse safely; do not reset it.
Store the spec at docs/timesheets/timesheet-spec.json.
Use synthetic data and a separate test Firebase project or emulator.
Verify the preview cannot write production data; a branch alone does not isolate Firebase.
done_when: Branch and testing environment are verified without changing production QR payloads or URLs.

steps.title: Define time records and shared services
actions: Use TypeScript and Luxon; install compatible typings if needed.
Separate capture, review, totals and persistence behind shared service interfaces.
Persist active, pending, needs_correction and approved records.
Use trusted backend timestamps and a transactionally enforced per-employee active-shift guard.
Use stable event IDs for idempotent capture and revision preconditions for edits.
done_when: Both manual and QR flows use the same rules and persistence service.

steps.title: Build the employee Timesheet page
actions: Reuse Sunny navigation, typography, cards, buttons and responsive styling.
Show clock status, current start time, elapsed time and Clock In or Clock Out.
Show week selector, approved hours, pending hours and shift history.
Provide Request Missing Hours and Request Correction with a required reason.
Design loading, empty, denied-access, save-progress and failure states.
done_when: A trainee can record a complete shift without a vehicle checklist.
Keyboard and mobile interaction are usable.

steps.title: Connect QR and return-checklist capture
actions: Start a shift when an authenticated employee scans the authorized vehicle-start QR.
After sign-in, accept a new authenticated punch; do not silently backdate an unauthenticated scan.
Do not create a punch from a general page visit or manager vehicle viewing.
Repeated scans or vehicle changes preserve the existing active shift.
Only successful return-checklist submission triggers automatic clock-out.
No active shift: preserve the checklist and offer Request Missing Hours.
Checklist saved but clock-out failed: preserve checklist, display failure and allow safe retry.
Do not claim offline punches were saved; provide the correction-request path.
done_when: QR and manual capture are idempotent.
Clock-out automatically creates a pending entry without another Submit action.

steps.title: Build manager review and approvals
actions: Add week, employee and status filters and a readable shift table; use cards on mobile.
Show start, end, break, net hours, source, status and attention flags.
Open an edit panel with original values, proposed values, notes and history.
Require a reason for manager changes.
Save Changes persists edits without approving a pending entry.
Approve & Save atomically saves approved values, reviewer metadata, revision and audit history.
Return for Correction requires a note.
Reject stale edits instead of overwriting another reviewer.
Use Amend & Approve with a reason for changes to approved shifts.
done_when: Each shift can be independently reviewed, corrected and approved.
Employees cannot approve or overwrite submitted or approved hours.

steps.title: Implement time calculations and weekly summaries
actions: Store instants in UTC with the location IANA time zone.
Calculate net seconds as elapsed seconds minus explicit unpaid-break seconds.
Round display values only; retain calculation precision.
Handle overnight shifts and actual elapsed DST hours.
Reject nonexistent local times and require offset selection for ambiguous manual times.
Reject end-before-start, zero-length shifts, negative or excessive breaks and overlaps.
Allow adjacent shifts sharing an endpoint.
Intersect completed shifts with local week boundaries converted to UTC.
Use the documented proportional break allocation assumption for cross-week shifts.
Exclude open shifts from finalized totals.
Keep the current approved version while its correction is pending; do not double-count it.
done_when: Weekly approved and pending totals are distinct and correct at time-zone and week boundaries.

steps.title: Enforce permissions and audit history
actions: Enforce ownership and manager location/team scope in backend checks or Firestore rules.
Derive employee identity from authentication rather than browser-supplied IDs.
Employees read their own records; managers review their authorized team.
Prevent manager self-approval as the prototype default.
Preserve original punches and before/after values, actor, timestamp, reason and revision.
Do not expose hard deletion of submitted or approved entries.
done_when: Direct unauthorized API/database access is rejected.
Approval and audit updates succeed or fail together.

steps.title: Run meaningful tests and produce quality reports
actions: Use the verified repository test framework; expected Vitest for units/components.
Use Firebase Emulator tests for rules and transactions and browser tests for end-to-end workflows.
Run required existing regression tests, type checks, repository checks and builds.
Report test pass/fail counts, coverage metrics, uncovered paths and commit ID.
Include all new timesheet production modules in coverage, including untested files.
done_when: Lines, branches, functions and statements each meet at least 80% coverage for new timesheet code.
Every critical time, permissions, approval and duplicate-event scenario is explicitly tested.

steps.title: Push and deliver the review preview
actions: Commit and push implementation to timesheet-branch only.
Verify branch preview uses test settings and has a visible prototype label.
Deliver preview URL, branch/commit links, review PR, seeded walkthrough, coverage report and known limitations.
Open review PR against the verified development branch.
Integrate through the existing reviewed development-to-production release process.
done_when: The manager can review the clean prototype independently.
No production rollout is implied by the prototype delivery.

data_model.storage: Firestore Timestamp for instants; ISO UTC strings for interchange. Final schema names must match repository conventions.

states.active: Start recorded, no end; clock-out transitions to pending.
states.pending: Completed shift or missing-hours request awaiting review.
states.needs_correction: Manager returned entry with a reason; employee revises and resubmits.
states.approved: Manager-approved version included in approved totals.

quality_gates.note: Coverage is not correctness. No required failing tests are permitted. No test results have been generated by this specification.

prototype_defaults_to_confirm.unpaid_breaks: Explicit recorded duration; no automatic deduction
prototype_defaults_to_confirm.cross_week_break_allocation: Proportional across elapsed segments, preserving full shift total

out_of_scope: Geofencing or proof of on-site presence

week_5_budget_hours.note: Planning target only. Report unfinished integration or emulator work explicitly.

acceptance_checks: Authenticated QR scan starts time before checklist completion.
Duplicate events preserve one active shift and the original start.
Successful return submission clocks out once and submits pending approval.
Timesheet buttons support a trainee shift without a checklist.
Missing hours and corrections reach manager review.
Manager edits require reasons and approvals retain audit history.
Pending and approved weekly totals remain accurate and separate.
Permissions, invalid times, overlaps and stale updates are enforced.
Reload preserves data and failed saves never display false success.
UI works on desktop, mobile and keyboard.
All required checks pass and all four coverage thresholds meet 80%.
An isolated preview and sample walkthrough are available for review.
references: Supplied Sunny Fleet project proposal and agreed design conversation
